title: Bug Hunt 1 - Score Keeper (forgot self)
body:
Goal: fix the 3 bugs in starter.py. When it works, Run prints:

Comet has 10 points

How to hunt:

  1. Press Run. Read the LAST line of the red error. Which line number?
  2. Click the Debug button (the bug icon, next to Run).
  3. Press Step into (F7) to go inside a method, and Step over (F6) to run one line at a time. Watch the Variables view (menu View > Variables).
  4. Fix one bug, run again, and repeat.

Hint (only if you are stuck): all three bugs are the same kind of mistake. Inside a class, the object's own data is always reached through... self.

hints.label: Hint 1
hints.title: Where to look
hints.html: Run the program and read the last line of the red error message. It tells you the line number to look at. Fix that one first, then run again to find the next one.

hints.label: Hint 2
hints.title: Try this
hints.html: Inside a class, a method gets the object it belongs to as its first input, and it reaches the object's own data through self. Look at how __init__ and add use self, and compare them with the other methods.

hints.label: Hint 3
hints.title: Almost there
hints.html: Check three places. Look at the def line of add and ask what it is missing. Look inside undo_last at score -= last. Look at {nickname} in report. Compare each with self.score and self.nickname as written in __init__.

starter.name: starter.py
starter.raw:
# Bug Hunt 1: Score Keeper
# This class has 3 bugs. Run it, read the red error message, and use the
# Thonny debugger (the bug button, then Step into / Step over) to find them.
# Expected output when fixed:  Comet has 10 points


class ScoreKeeper:
    """Keeps one player's score and remembers every change so it can undo."""

    def __init__(self, nickname):
        self.nickname = nickname
        self.score = 0
        self.history = []

    def add(points):
        self.score = self.score + points
        self.history.append(points)

    def undo_last(self):
        if len(self.history) > 0:
            last = self.history.pop()
            score -= last

    def report(self):
        return f"{nickname} has {self.score} points"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    keeper = ScoreKeeper("Comet")
    keeper.add(10)
    keeper.add(5)
    keeper.undo_last()
    print(keeper.report())
